status: prospective; no new competition OOF fusion score calculated
hypothesis: A fixed ensemble can improve ranking through the score-combination rule without training another model. Compare three fixed rules to the current weighted probability mean, retaining the same atomic models and weights.

definitions.logit: Clip each source probability to[1e-6,1-1e-6], take log(p/(1-p)), weighted mean, stable sigmoid.
definitions.rank: For each source separately, average-tie rank/(n+1); weighted mean of normalized ranks. Rank the full OOF vector and the full test vector separately; no labels enter this transform.
definitions.rank_logit: Average-tie ranks/(n+1), clipped at1e-6 as above, then weighted mean of logits and stable sigmoid.
definitions.unchanged_default: The probability mode must preserve the existing arithmetic and predictions exactly. Existing blend calls default to probability.

validation: Reuse the frozen699960 out-of-fold predictions, known labels and exact StratifiedKFold5/42 assignments. This is exploratory model selection on previously used OOF labels, not fresh nested CV or an independent holdout. Rank-based transforms also use the unlabeled score distribution of the evaluated vector. No new training or public-score tuning.
selection: Report all three spaces. Among candidates exceeding R10 pooled OOF by strictly more than0.0001 and improving at least4/5 matching folds, select the highest pooled OOF. Do not add spaces, change weights, clip thresholds or evaluate extra rank calibrations after seeing the result.
submission_rule: At most one R15 submission, after independent source/data/ID/fold/label/formula and output checks. Also require its pooled OOF to exceed any already-selected R13/R14 candidate, avoiding submission of a locally dominated composition. If no candidate passes, record the negative result and retain the better validated model. No exception preauthorized.
provenance: Retain direct source coefficients in the declared score space. A coefficient on logits or ranks is not a percentage contribution to a probability. Do not flatten nested nonlinear mixtures into misleading effective probability weights.
training_gate: Publish this plan and tested blend-space implementation before calculating these competition AUCs. Run from a clean pinned worktree. Only existing licensed/provenance-approved sources; no additional prediction dataset or paid compute.
